title: 第23章 两尊大帝现身第24章 结盟
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
此刻。
外界无数不朽道统，隐世古族，禁忌势力，以及躲藏于阴暗角落的老鼠们，见此一幕无不心神颤抖！
这等无上帝威！
恐怕就算是黑暗纪元前的那几位巅峰大帝，也是望尘莫及！
不过想来也是。
虽然如今诸天处于黑暗纪元，天道残缺，无人能够再成就大帝，但对于已经成为大帝的苏红夜而言，丝毫不受影响啊！
二十万年的时间里，又是诸天当中唯一一位没有被邪魔炁气污染的大帝。
无数资源无人敢与其争夺。
这般情况之下。
众多强者心中惊疑。
这位女帝，是否达到了那个传说中的境界？
想到这里，他们内心恐慌更甚。
“赶紧将那位神子殿下的容貌，画出来给族中之人看清楚了！
决不可招惹到那位小祖宗！”
“这是什么情况啊？不是有达成过协议吗？”
“不清楚，那是二十万年前的事了，看如今红夜女帝修为更进一步，只怕诸天要重新洗牌！
快去告诉老祖，询问一下究竟是何情况！”
……
与此同时，苏红夜极具威严的声音在诸天中响起。
“本帝苏红夜，今日昭告诸天！”

“尔等若再有人敢对本帝儿子出手，以大欺小，下场便与这天道院一样，连同整个道域一起毁灭！”
“上天入地，不死不休！”
姜夜见此一幕，同样也是眼神火热。
这般无上至强的力量，挥手间便是翻天覆地，举手投足间覆灭整个道域！
无不令人向往！
令人惊骇的无上帝威渐渐消散。
苏红夜目光温柔地看向姜夜，轻声道：“乖儿子，有娘在，今后不管哪个势力敢对你出手，娘直接出手灭了它！”
姜夜眼神有些担忧地问道：“您这般出手，不影响自身底蕴吗？”
他原本是想着灭掉天道院就差不多了。
但哪知自家母亲，直接出手覆灭一整个道域？
不过这倒也是省了很多功夫。
毕竟整个海德道域，基本都以天道院为尊。
天道传承的后花园，全部灭掉，也就免掉了后续一系列的麻烦事。
“你这小坏蛋，总算知道心痛娘了，不错有进步！”
“不过娘跟你说，娘现在已踏入帝境巅峰，乃无上帝之极境！
content_en:
now.
Countless immortal sects, hidden ancient clans, taboo forces, and rats hiding in dark corners in the outside world all trembled when they saw this scene!
Such lack of divine authority!
I am afraid that even those peak emperors from before the Dark Age are far behind!
But come to think of it.
Although the world is now in a dark era, the way of heaven is incomplete, and no one can become a great emperor, Su Hongye, who has become the great emperor, is not affected at all!
In two hundred thousand years, he was the only emperor in the world who was not contaminated by the energy of evil spirits.
There are countless resources that no one dares to compete with.
Under such circumstances.
Many strong men were shocked and doubtful.
Has this empress reached that legendary realm?
Thinking of this, they panicked even more.
"Hurry up and draw the appearance of His Highness the Son of God so that the people in the clan can see clearly!
Never mess with that little ancestor! "
"What's going on? Wasn't there an agreement?"
"I don't know, that was 200,000 years ago. Seeing that the Empress Red Night has advanced further now, I'm afraid the heavens will reshuffle the cards!
Go tell the ancestors quickly and ask what is going on! "
…
At the same time, Su Hongye's majestic voice sounded in the heavens.
"This Emperor, Su Hongye, will tell the heavens today!"
"If anyone dares to take action against this emperor's son again and bully the younger ones, the fate will be the same as this Tian Dao Temple, and the entire Dao domain will be destroyed together!"
"Go to heaven and go to earth, till death!"
When Jiang Ye saw this scene, his eyes were also fiery.
Such supreme and powerful power can turn the world upside down with a wave of his hand, and destroy the entire Dao realm with a single movement of his hand!
All very desirable!
The terrifying power of God gradually dissipated.
Su Hongye looked at Jiang Ye with gentle eyes and said softly: "My dear son, as long as my mother is here, no matter which force dares to attack you from now on, my mother will directly destroy it!"
Jiang Ye asked with a worried look, "Will your actions not affect your own foundation?"
He originally thought that destroying the Tiandao Academy would be enough.
But who would have thought that his mother would directly destroy an entire Dao realm?
But this saves a lot of effort.
After all, the entire Haide Dao Domain is basically respected by Tiandao Academy.
By destroying all the back gardens of the Tiandao inheritance, a series of subsequent troubles will be avoided.
"You little rascal, you finally know how sad your mother is. You've made some progress!"
“But I’m telling you, I’ve reached the pinnacle of the Emperor Realm now, the ultimate realm without God!
